About

Chasing light
across continents

A photographer who wanders — from the frozen silence of Antarctica to the warm chaos of India, the cobblestoned lanes of Porto to the punted waterways of Cambridge.

Still early in the journey, but every frame is a study in patience, light, and being exactly where you need to be at exactly the right moment.

Currently based in Porto, with a lens always pointed somewhere new.
